import React from 'react'; import { Link, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom'; export default function BottomNav({role}){const loc=useLocation();const p=role==='customer'?'/dashboard-customer':'/dashboard-worker';const items=[{icon:'🏠',label:'Home',path:p},{icon:'📋',label:'Orders',path:'/order-status'},{icon:'💬',label:'Chat',path:'/inbox'},{icon:'💳',label:'Wallet',path:'/wallet'},{icon:'👤',label:'Profile',path:'/worker-profile'}];return(
{items.map((x,i)=>{x.icon}{x.label})}
)}
